title: A Room for the Choir
author: Isandro Blackwood
blurb: Sable Quintana, a hospice nurse who hears the dying count backwards, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. Then the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in before the well refills.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
